baseline_models.mechanism: An observer classifies visible bodies as awake, but the coordinated clause immediately overrides that classification as sleep; posture is insufficient evidence of inner state.

activation_trace.role: Supposition makes the observer's state-classification provisional.
Literal wakefulness supplies the appearance assigned by the observer.
Sleep and stillness supply the concealed state that corrects the appearance.

changed_reading.before: They look awake although they are asleep.
changed_reading.after: The opening is a miniature failed inference: a confident visual classification coexists with its explicit correction.

baseline_models.mechanism: Directed alternation from side to side turns prolonged repose into an externally maintained equilibrium; stillness is preserved through repeated movement.

activation_trace.role: Turning a thing from face to face supplies the repeated maintenance operation.
The right side supplies one pole of controlled alternation.
The left side supplies the opposed pole that completes the alternation.

changed_reading.before: The sleepers are periodically rolled onto either side.
changed_reading.after: Their repose is a managed steady state: preservation is enacted through calibrated reversal.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَكَلْبُهُم بَاسِطٌ ذِرَاعَيْهِ بِٱلْوَصِيدِ ... لَوَلَّيْتَ مِنْهُمْ فِرَارًا
baseline_models.mechanism: The dog and its extended forelegs occupy the entrance-space; an attempted look across that boundary produces immediate reversal and fear. Posture, threshold, and affect regulate access.

activation_trace.role: The literal dog supplies the animate figure stationed at the boundary.
Spreading and extension turn the dog's body into a horizontal occupation of space.
The courtyard or threshold supplies the dog's liminal station.
The connected door-space sharpens the boundary as an access point.
Looking in and uncovering the matter supplies the attempted boundary crossing.
Turning away supplies the barrier's immediate behavioral effect.
Fear supplies the affective force that expels the viewer.

changed_reading.before: A dog lies at the entrance, and the sleepers look frightening.
changed_reading.after: The verse composes an access-control scene: a body spans the threshold and the would-be viewer is forced back before inspection becomes entry.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context moves from supposition about the cave, through exhaustive reckoning and the sleepers' failed duration estimate, to conjecture about the unseen and finally true sight. The focus becomes the sensory demonstration of epistemic asymmetry.

activation_trace.role: The focus observer's supposition supplies the local misclassification.
The earlier supposition frames the episode as a problem of what one estimates to be extraordinary.
Exhaustive numerical reckoning intensifies the question from impression to exact knowledge.
Repeated duration language exposes the sleepers' own short estimate as inadequate.
Guessing at the unseen names the overreach that the focus observer performs visually.
True seeing closes the sequence by contrasting with the observer's misleading sight.

structural_cues: In 18:18 the corrective وَهُمْ رُقُودٌ follows the observer's supposition without resolving it through closer inspection.
The one-day estimate in 18:19 precedes the explicit three-hundred-plus-nine duration in 18:25.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies supposition, reckoning, failed duration estimates, unseen conjecture, and seeing; I infer that their sequence makes 18:18 an epistemic calibration scene. A live alternative is that the repetitions only coordinate chronology.

changed_reading.before: The observer happens to mistake sleeping bodies for waking ones.
changed_reading.after: The mistake is an embodied epistemic test: sight, self-report, and numerical conjecture fail to master a state whose measure remains hidden.

context_deltas.mechanism: Auditory closure, awakening from stillness, solar deflection, solar passage to the side, and the cave's open interval turn bodily rotation into one operation within a coordinated preservation system.

activation_trace.role: Repeated face-to-face turning supplies bodily maintenance.
Withholding and checking supply the functional image for suspended auditory input.
Rousing a still thing supplies the controlled terminal reversal of sleep.
The sun's veering supplies regulated avoidance at one edge of the daily cycle.
Passing the place to one side supplies complementary solar movement.
The widened interval supplies spatial clearance inside the enclosure.
The later rousing closes the preservation interval and returns the bodies to agency.

structural_cues: The sequence encloses 18:18 between auditory suspension in 18:11, solar routing in 18:17, and awakening in 18:19.
The repeated right/left construction in 18:17 and 18:18 coordinates environmental and bodily orientation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies auditory checking, solar movement, open space, bodily turning, and rousing; I infer a coordinated input-and-position management system. A live alternative is that each protection operates independently.

changed_reading.before: Turning prevents harm during a long sleep.
changed_reading.after: Turning is one actuator in a larger preservation regime regulating sound, light, space, posture, and return to agency.

context_deltas.mechanism: Withdrawal and refuge establish a hidden zone; the focus repels an attempted look at its threshold; later discovery is allowed. The boundary protects not permanent secrecy but the timing of disclosure.

activation_trace.role: The connected door-space supplies the line between hidden interior and approaching viewer.
Inspection supplies the premature disclosure attempt.
Withdrawal supplies the threshold's repelling effect.
Deliberate separation supplies the social boundary that the cave spatializes.
Refuge gives the separated group a protected interior.
Discovery names the feared premature breach of concealment.
Finding what was hidden supplies the later authorized disclosure.

structural_cues: The counterfactual لو اطلعت ... لوليت binds attempted inspection directly to expulsion.
The feared discovery of 18:20 is followed by causative disclosure in 18:21.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies withdrawal, refuge, repelled inspection, feared discovery, and actual discovery; I infer that the boundary controls disclosure timing. A live alternative is that the terror is independent of later publicity.

changed_reading.before: The entrance simply keeps outsiders away.
changed_reading.after: The entrance enforces a temporary disclosure embargo: access is repelled during preservation, then the hidden group is deliberately made known.

context_deltas.mechanism: The youths' hearts are bound firm, and they fear hostile discovery and stoning. In the focus scene force reverses: the outsider turns and is filled with fear while the sleepers remain undisturbed.

activation_trace.role: The viewer's retreat realizes the reversed direction of social force.
Fear supplies the force transferred onto the approaching observer.
Binding the heart supplies the youths' prior affective firmness.
The literal heart locates that firmness internally and activates the focus root's heart branch.
Stones supply the concrete violence the youths expect from discovery.

structural_cues: The hidden group is threatened by discoverers in 18:20, whereas the approaching second-person observer is expelled in 18:18.
The focus juxtaposes externally turned bodies with an internally overwhelmed viewer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies firm hearts, threatened stoning, viewer retreat, and viewer terror; I infer a deliberate reversal of the threat vector. A live alternative is that these are parallel protections without role reversal.

changed_reading.before: A vulnerable hidden group is made frightening to an intruder.
changed_reading.after: Protection reverses the power relation: the group threatened by discovery remains firm while hostile approach is converted into the outsider's flight.

context_deltas.mechanism: The dog is possessed by the companions in the focus and recurs unchanged in every proposed count. Its threshold posture marks a member stationed at the margin, not an unrelated animal outside the group.

activation_trace.role: The literal dog is grammatically theirs while physically stationed at the entrance.
Companionship supplies the social category within which the animal is counted.
The dog remains the invariant added term in all three competing enumerations.
Enumeration makes the dog's repeated inclusion evidence of group composition.

structural_cues: The possessive كَلْبُهُمْ recurs in every numerical proposal in 18:22.
In 18:18 the possessive links the dog to the sleepers while the threshold separates its position from theirs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies companionship, possessive attachment, threshold location, and invariant inclusion in counts; I infer liminal membership. A live alternative is that the dog is counted only as a memorable accessory.

changed_reading.before: The dog is an external guard lying near the group.
changed_reading.after: The dog is a companion-at-the-margin: socially included in the group while its body occupies the group's outer boundary.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activates a tool-sense of كلب rather than the focus word's literal animal sense. It remains anchored by the literal dog, spread posture, and closed-door threshold branch. Render only as a material analogy: the dog functions like a clasp across access, not as a replacement meaning for 'dog.'

activation_trace.role: The hooked implement that holds supplies a latch-like material analogy for the literal dog.
Extending a limb supplies the spanning action of the analogy.
A firmly closed door supplies the access point across which the dog acts latch-like.

changed_reading.before: The dog guards the doorway by presence.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material overlay, the dog and its forelegs form a living clasp across the cave's access point.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The water-filled valley is a distant branch of رعب, while the focus uses fear. It remains anchored by the explicit filling verb governing terror. Render as an image-level overlay: fear inundates a bounded capacity, without claiming that رعب literally means water here.

activation_trace.role: Filling to a container's measure casts the observer as fully occupied.
A torrent filling a valley supplies the inundation image for the fear occupying the observer.

changed_reading.after: As an exploratory material image, terror floods the observer until no capacity for approach remains.

strongest_changes: Apparent wakefulness becomes an embodied test of sight, counting, and conjecture.
Turning becomes one actuator in a coordinated preservation system.
The threshold protects the timing of disclosure rather than permanent secrecy.
The focus reverses the threatened youths' vulnerability onto the approaching observer.
The repeatedly counted dog reads as a group member stationed at its margin.
summary.what_was_special: The focus compresses epistemic error, bodily maintenance, boundary control, social reversal, and companion membership into one visual tableau without collapsing them into a single interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: System-level coordination is inferred from sequence rather than explicitly stated causation.
The disclosure model may overconnect the hypothetical viewer with later publicity.
The latch and inundation readings are branch-backed analogies and must remain exploratory.
